notes: 'that which' is given to the purpose לְ as the complementizer of its recast clause; the supplied lexical verb 'will bring' answers to no morpheme and is added.
The final clause's 'there is' is placed on the prepositional predicate עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל under rules 49 and 20; attaching it to the חֲרוֹן אָף nominal was the competing reading.
לָנוּ → 'our' fuses the possessive preposition with its suffix under rules 30 and 49; leaving the לְ unrepresented was the competing reading.
